3	from __future__ import annotations
4	
5	import csv
6	import datetime as dt
7	from pathlib import Path
8	
9	from mdata.types import RawRow
10	
11	COLUMNS = ("date", "ticker", "close")
12	
13	
14	def read_csv(path: str | Path) -> list[RawRow]:
15	    """Every row in file order; a blank close is None, not zero (DATA-01)."""
16	    with Path(path).open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
17	        reader = csv.DictReader(handle, restval="")
18	        missing = [column for column in COLUMNS if column not in (reader.fieldnames or ())]
19	        if missing:
20	            raise ValueError(f"{path}: missing column(s) {', '.join(missing)}")
21	        return [_parse_row(record, reader.line_num) for record in reader]
22	
23	
24	def _parse_row(record: dict[str, str], line: int) -> RawRow:
25	    date = record["date"].strip()
26	    if not _is_iso_date(date):
27	        raise ValueError(f"line {line}: malformed date {date!r}")
28	    close = record["close"].strip()
29	    try:
30	        value = float(close) if close else None
31	    except ValueError as error:
32	        raise ValueError(f"line {line}: malformed close {close!r}") from error
33	    return RawRow(date=date, ticker=record["ticker"].strip(), close=value)

36	def _is_iso_date(text: str) -> bool:
37	    try:
38	        return dt.date.fromisoformat(text).isoformat() == text
